component.name: Wipemark
component.summary: Strips AI provenance marks from your own content

description.p: Wipemark finds and removes the provenance marks AI tools leave in text and pictures you made with them: invisible Unicode characters and look-alike letters in text, provenance metadata in PNG, JPEG and WebP, and the visible marks of Gemini and Grok on X.

Cleaning is deterministic and runs on this computer. Rewriting a text runs a language model on this computer, or on an endpoint you choose. A command-line tool and an MCP server for agents come with it.
